objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the business logic weakness of a PHP login form of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant that guards the admin welcome page and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Look at which values the login flow trusts from the client.
Look for a value that decides your role and that you can influence.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which kind of flaw lets you bypass the check without breaking any crypto or injecting anything?
